words.enDefinition: the online platform where a university runs its courses

examples.en: Check the learning management system every morning for new announcements.
examples.zh: 每天早上先去「学习管理系统」上看有没有新通知。

examples.en: Our professor posts slides, quizzes, and grades on the learning management system.
examples.zh: 教授把课件、测验和成绩都放在「学习管理系统」上。

collocations: log into the learning management system
post on the learning management system

words.enDefinition: the webpage for one class on the school platform

examples.en: The professor updated the course page with this week's reading last night.
examples.zh: 教授昨晚在「课程页面」上更新了本周的阅读材料。

examples.en: Everything for the class lives on the course page, including old exams.
examples.zh: 这门课的所有内容都在「课程页面」上，包括往年考题。

words.enDefinition: the home screen listing your courses and upcoming deadlines

examples.en: The course dashboard shows red dots on anything due within two days.
examples.zh: 「课程主页」上两天内要交的作业都会标红点。

examples.en: I check my course dashboard before breakfast to see what's due.
examples.zh: 我早饭前先看一眼「课程主页」，确认今天要交什么。

words.enDefinition: a self-contained course unit with its own materials and tasks

examples.en: The new course module opens Monday with a quiz and a short essay.
examples.zh: 新的「课程模块」周一开放，包含一次测验和一篇短文。

examples.en: Each course module ends with a checklist so you know you finished everything.
examples.zh: 每个「课程模块」结尾都有清单，方便确认全部完成。

words.enDefinition: to make an online course unit available to students

examples.en: The instructor will unlock a module each Monday, starting with the course overview.
examples.zh: 讲师从课程概览开始，每周一「解锁一个模块」。

examples.en: Our course uses quiz results to unlock a module once we complete its prerequisites.
examples.zh: 我们的课以测验成绩为依据，修完前置内容后就会「解锁一个模块」。

collocations: unlock a module on a set date
unlock a module after a quiz
unlock a module for enrolled students

words.enDefinition: files, readings, and videos the professor shares for class

examples.en: All the course materials are posted under the weekly tabs on the site.
examples.zh: 所有「课程资料」都放在网站的每周标签页下面。

examples.en: Download the course materials before class in case the campus Wi-Fi acts up.
examples.zh: 课前先把「课程资料」下载好，以防校园网出问题。

words.enDefinition: an official notice a professor posts for the whole class

examples.en: Read the course announcement carefully because the quiz moved to Thursday.
examples.zh: 仔细读「课程公告」，测验改到周四了。

examples.en: Many students missed the course announcement about the room change, so the TA emailed us.
examples.zh: 很多同学没看到教室调整的「课程公告」，助教只好再发邮件。

words.enDefinition: a message fixed to the top of a page so nobody misses it

examples.en: The professor kept a pinned post with the Zoom link and office hours.
examples.zh: 教授置顶了一个「置顶帖」，里面是Zoom链接和答疑时间。

examples.en: Check the pinned post first because it answers most questions about the final.
examples.zh: 先看「置顶帖」，它解答了关于期末考的大部分问题。

words.enDefinition: a link that no longer opens the page or file it should

examples.en: I emailed the TA after finding a broken link to the required reading.
examples.zh: 我发现必读材料用的是「失效链接」，于是给助教发了邮件。

examples.en: The professor fixed a broken link in module two just before the deadline.
examples.zh: 教授在截止前修复了模块二里的一个「失效链接」。

words.enDefinition: planned downtime when an online system is temporarily unavailable

examples.en: The portal was down all night for scheduled maintenance before enrollment.
examples.zh: 选课前夜，门户系统整晚都在「系统维护」。

examples.en: The LMS warned us about scheduled maintenance this Sunday from two to four.
examples.zh: 系统提示本周日两点到四点进行「系统维护」。

words.enDefinition: delete temporary browser files so a website loads properly

examples.en: Support told me to clear the cache and restart the browser before the quiz.
examples.zh: 客服让我测验前先「清除缓存」再重启浏览器。

examples.en: The grades weren't showing until I cleared the cache on my laptop.
examples.zh: 直到我「清除缓存」之后，成绩才显示出来。

words.enDefinition: a browser setting that stops websites opening new pop-up windows

examples.en: Turn off your pop-up blocker or the quiz window won't open.
examples.zh: 关掉「弹窗拦截器」，不然测验窗口弹不出来。

examples.en: My pop-up blocker kept the poll from loading during the lecture.
examples.zh: 上课时「弹窗拦截器」把投票页面挡住了，一直加载不出来。

words.enDefinition: create a new password after forgetting or losing the old one

examples.en: I got locked out of the portal and had to reset my password before class.
examples.zh: 我登不进系统，上课前只好「重置密码」。

examples.en: Reset your password through your school email if the portal rejects it.
examples.zh: 如果门户系统不认你的密码，就用学校邮箱去「重置密码」。

words.enDefinition: a login needing your password plus a code from your phone

examples.en: The portal added two-factor authentication, so keep your phone nearby at login.
examples.zh: 门户系统加了「两步验证」，登录时手机要放在身边。

examples.en: Two-factor authentication texts me a code every time I open the LMS.
examples.zh: 每次打开学习管理系统，「两步验证」都会给我发验证码。

words.enDefinition: automatic logout after a page sits inactive for too long

examples.en: A session timeout kicked me out mid-quiz, but my answers were saved.
examples.zh: 测验做到一半「会话超时」把我踢了出去，好在答案都保存了。

examples.en: I saved the essay draft before the session timeout could close the page.
examples.zh: 我在「会话超时」关掉页面前保存了论文草稿。

words.enDefinition: reload a webpage to get the newest version of it

examples.en: Refresh the page right at noon or the sign-up slots fill instantly.
examples.zh: 中午整点要马上「刷新页面」，不然名额瞬间被抢光。

examples.en: If the poll doesn't appear, refresh the page and wait a few seconds.
examples.zh: 如果投票没弹出来，就「刷新页面」再等几秒。

collocations: refresh the page and try again

words.enDefinition: store an unfinished post or message before you submit it

examples.en: Save a draft of your discussion post so the site can't eat it.
examples.zh: 讨论帖先「保存草稿」，免得网站把内容吞掉。

examples.en: I always save a draft before submitting anything on the LMS.
examples.zh: 在系统上交东西之前，我都会先「保存草稿」。

collocations: save a draft of your post

words.enDefinition: a purchased code that unlocks the online materials for a course

examples.en: You need an access code from the bookstore to open the online homework.
examples.zh: 需要书店卖的「访问码」才能打开在线作业。

examples.en: Don't buy the used textbook if the access code is already scratched off.
examples.zh: 如果「访问码」已经被刮开，就别买那本二手课本了。

words.enDefinition: an automatic email alerting you to new activity on a platform

examples.en: Turn on email notifications so you never miss a course announcement.
examples.zh: 打开「邮件通知」，就不会漏掉课程公告了。

examples.en: I set email notifications for grades because the app's alerts are unreliable.
examples.zh: 成绩的「邮件通知」我都开着，因为App提醒不靠谱。

words.enDefinition: use a browser tool to display a page in another language

examples.en: I translate the page to double-check deadlines written in complicated English.
examples.zh: 我会「翻译网页」，核对写得复杂的截止时间。

examples.en: Right-click and translate the page if the instructions feel unclear.
examples.zh: 如果说明看不太懂，就右键「翻译网页」。

words.enDefinition: tick an item in the platform to record that you finished it

examples.en: Mark each item as done in the module so the progress bar fills.
examples.zh: 模块里的每一项都要「标记完成」，进度条才会涨。

examples.en: I marked the orientation module as done before my first advising meeting.
examples.zh: 第一次约导师之前，我把入学模块全部「标记完成」了。

collocations: mark as done before the deadline

words.enDefinition: an online space where a class meets, talks, and shares work

examples.en: Our seminar meets in a virtual classroom with a shared whiteboard.
examples.zh: 我们研讨课在「虚拟教室」上，还带共享白板。

examples.en: The virtual classroom keeps a chat log you can read after class.
examples.zh: 「虚拟教室」会保留聊天记录，下课后可以回看。

words.enDefinition: a live class held over the Zoom video app

examples.en: My eight a.m. Zoom class lets us keep cameras off, honestly a blessing.
examples.zh: 早上八点的「Zoom网课」可以不开摄像头，简直是福音。

examples.en: I joined the Zoom class from the library because my roommate was blasting music.
examples.zh: 室友放歌太吵，我去图书馆上了「Zoom网课」。

words.enDefinition: the clickable web address that takes you into a Zoom meeting

examples.en: The professor posted the Zoom link five minutes after class was supposed to start.
examples.zh: 该上课了教授才把「Zoom链接」发出来，晚了五分钟。

examples.en: Save the Zoom link to your calendar so you don't dig through email.
examples.zh: 把「Zoom链接」存进日历，省得到邮件里翻找。

words.enDefinition: a shared web address for joining an online meeting

examples.en: The TA sends a fresh meeting link every week before the review session.
examples.zh: 助教每周复习课前都会发一个新的「会议链接」。

examples.en: Please don't share the meeting link with anyone outside the class roster.
examples.zh: 请不要把「会议链接」转发给选课名单以外的人。

words.enDefinition: the number you enter to join a specific online meeting

examples.en: Type the meeting ID and passcode from the email to get in.
examples.zh: 输入邮件里的「会议号」和密码就能进去。

examples.en: I copied the wrong meeting ID and ended up in a stranger's study group.
examples.zh: 我抄错了「会议号」，进了一个陌生人的学习小组。

words.enDefinition: a holding area where people wait until the host lets them in

examples.en: I sat in the Zoom waiting room for ten minutes because the professor was late.
examples.zh: 教授迟到了，我在「Zoom等候室」干等了十分钟。

examples.en: The TA admits everyone from the Zoom waiting room once the slides are ready.
examples.zh: 幻灯片放好以后，助教再把大家从「Zoom等候室」放进来。

collocations: wait in the Zoom waiting room
admit students from the waiting room

words.enDefinition: the name other people see next to you in a meeting

examples.en: The professor asked everyone to change their display name to their real name.
examples.zh: 教授要求大家把「显示名称」改成真实姓名。

examples.en: My display name still shows my English nickname from high school.
examples.zh: 我的「显示名称」还是高中时的英文昵称。

words.enDefinition: a fake image that hides the room behind you on camera

examples.en: I set a virtual background because my dorm wall is completely bare.
examples.zh: 我设了个「虚拟背景」，因为宿舍墙壁实在太空了。

examples.en: Her virtual background kept glitching every time she waved her hands.
examples.zh: 她一挥手，「虚拟背景」就不停地闪。

collocations: blur or use a virtual background

words.enDefinition: a meeting layout showing everyone's video in small boxes at once

examples.en: Switch to gallery view so you can see who's nodding along in discussion.
examples.zh: 切到「九宫格视图」，就能看到讨论时谁在点头。

examples.en: In gallery view I counted only six cameras on in a class of forty.
examples.zh: 在「九宫格视图」里一看，四十人的课只有六个人开了摄像头。

words.enDefinition: a meeting layout that fills the screen with whoever is talking

examples.en: I use speaker view during lectures so the professor's slides stay big.
examples.zh: 听课时我用「演讲者视图」，画面更大更清楚。

examples.en: Speaker view jumps between faces whenever someone coughs into their mic.
examples.zh: 谁对着麦克风咳嗽一声，「演讲者视图」就切到谁。

words.enDefinition: tap a quick emoji like a thumbs-up that floats on screen

examples.en: Just send a reaction instead of unmuting when you agree with an answer.
examples.zh: 同意别人观点时发个「表情反馈」就行，不用开麦。

examples.en: Everyone sent a reaction when the professor announced the quiz was canceled.
examples.zh: 教授宣布测验取消时，所有人都发了「表情反馈」。

words.enDefinition: the person who controls a meeting and lets people in

examples.en: The TA is the meeting host, so message her if the room won't let you in.
examples.zh: 助教是「会议主持人」，进不去房间就私信她。

examples.en: The meeting host can mute all of us during the guest lecture.
examples.zh: 嘉宾讲课时，「会议主持人」可以先全体静音。

words.enDefinition: enter an online meeting with a link, ID, or code

examples.en: Join the meeting five minutes early to test your audio and camera.
examples.zh: 提前五分钟「加入会议」，测试一下音频和摄像头。

examples.en: She joined the meeting from the train and stayed muted the whole time.
examples.zh: 她在火车上「加入了会议」，全程保持静音。

collocations: join the meeting from your phone
remind everyone to join the meeting

words.enDefinition: come back into a meeting after your connection drops

examples.en: My screen froze, so I left and rejoined the meeting within a minute.
examples.zh: 画面卡住之后，我退出并在一分钟内「重新加入会议」。

examples.en: If the audio cuts out, rejoin the meeting before restarting your laptop.
examples.zh: 如果音频断了，先「重新加入会议」，别急着重启电脑。

collocations: rejoin the meeting with new audio

words.enDefinition: suddenly removed from a call, usually by a bad connection
acceptedEnVariants: got kicked out of the meeting

examples.en: My dorm Wi-Fi kicked me out of the meeting right before the quiz.
examples.zh: 宿舍Wi-Fi不给力，测验开始前把我「踢出了会议」。

examples.en: He got kicked out of the meeting twice and finally called in from his phone.
examples.zh: 他被「踢出会议」两次，最后干脆用手机拨入。

collocations: get kicked out of the meeting
kicked out of the meeting again

words.enDefinition: using the laptop's own microphone and speakers for sound in a call

examples.en: Choose computer audio when you join, or Zoom will dial your phone.
examples.zh: 入会时选「电脑音频」，不然Zoom会拨打你手机。

examples.en: My computer audio wasn't working, so I switched to my earbuds' mic.
examples.zh: 「电脑音频」出了问题，我改用耳机上的麦克风。

words.enDefinition: the internet capacity available for video calls and streaming

examples.en: Everyone streaming at once eats up the dorm's bandwidth around midnight.
examples.zh: 半夜大家一起看视频，宿舍楼的「带宽」根本不够用。

examples.en: Turn off your video to save bandwidth when the connection gets choppy.
examples.zh: 网络卡的时候关掉视频，省点「带宽」。

words.enDefinition: an extra screen connected to your laptop for more workspace

examples.en: I put the lecture on my second monitor and my notes on the laptop.
examples.zh: 我把讲课画面放到「外接显示器」上，笔记本屏幕用来记笔记。

examples.en: A second monitor makes split-screen note-taking during lectures way easier.
examples.zh: 有「外接显示器」，边听课边记笔记轻松多了。

collocations: drag the slides to the second monitor

words.enDefinition: headphones that block background sound so you can hear clearly

examples.en: Noise-cancelling headphones save me when my neighbors start vacuuming mid-lecture.
examples.zh: 室友上课中途吸尘，全靠「降噪耳机」救场。

examples.en: Wear noise-cancelling headphones in the library so the lecture stays clear.
examples.zh: 在图书馆听课戴上「降噪耳机」，声音清楚多了。

words.enDefinition: a small slider that physically blocks your laptop camera

examples.en: I stuck a webcam cover on my laptop after reading about hackers.
examples.zh: 看到黑客盗号的新闻后，我在笔记本上贴了「摄像头遮挡片」。

examples.en: A webcam cover is cheap insurance against accidentally broadcasting your room.
examples.zh: 「摄像头遮挡片」很便宜，能防止不小心把房间直播出去。

collocations: a webcam cover over the lens

words.enDefinition: an electronic request that adds a class event to your calendar

examples.en: The TA sent a calendar invite for Thursday's review session.
examples.zh: 助教给周四的复习课发了「日历邀请」。

examples.en: Accept the calendar invite so the class shows up on your schedule.
examples.zh: 记得接受「日历邀请」，课程才会出现在你的日程里。

collocations: a calendar invite for the session

words.enDefinition: a lecture broadcast in real time for students watching elsewhere

examples.en: The live lecture stream froze halfway, so half the class missed the derivation.
examples.zh: 「直播课堂」中途卡住了，一半同学没看到那步推导。

examples.en: Commuter students watch the live lecture stream from home on snowy days.
examples.zh: 下雪天，走读的同学在家看「直播课堂」。

words.enDefinition: a saved video of a lecture you can watch after class

examples.en: The lecture recording is usually posted within two hours after class.
examples.zh: 「课程回放」一般在课后两小时内上传。

examples.en: I fell asleep during class but caught up with the lecture recording that night.
examples.zh: 上课时睡着了，当晚看「课程回放」补上了。

words.enDefinition: the system that automatically records lectures and uploads them

examples.en: Our lecture capture only films the projector screen, not the professor.
examples.zh: 我们的「录播系统」只拍投影幕布，不拍教授。

examples.en: Check lecture capture before skipping class because some professors stop the recording.
examples.zh: 翘课前先确认「录播系统」开着，有的教授会手动停录。

words.enDefinition: how fast a recorded video plays compared with normal speed

examples.en: I watch every lecture recording at double playback speed before the exam.
examples.zh: 考前我用「倍速播放」把所有回放刷一遍。

examples.en: Adjust the playback speed to 1.5x for the slow review lectures.
examples.zh: 复习课讲得慢，把「倍速」调到1.5倍就行。

words.enDefinition: text of the spoken words shown on a video

examples.en: Turn on closed captions when the professor mumbles or talks too fast.
examples.zh: 教授吐字不清或语速太快时，就打开「隐藏式字幕」。

examples.en: The closed captions garbled several technical terms, so double-check the slides.
examples.zh: 「字幕」把好几个术语识别错了，记得对照幻灯片检查。

words.enDefinition: captions created by software without a human checking them

examples.en: The auto-generated captions turned 'derivative' into a completely different word.
examples.zh: 「自动生成字幕」把derivative识别成了完全另一个词。

examples.en: Auto-generated captions help when you rewatch a lecture at double speed.
examples.zh: 用双倍速重看回放时，「自动生成字幕」特别有用。

words.enDefinition: switch on the text track while watching a video or call

examples.en: Turn on captions if the guest speaker's accent is hard to follow.
examples.zh: 嘉宾口音难懂的话，就「打开字幕」。

examples.en: Remember to turn on captions before you start the recorded lecture.
examples.zh: 看回放之前记得先「打开字幕」。

collocations: turn on captions for the video

words.enDefinition: the full written text of a recorded lecture or video

examples.en: Search the video transcript for 'midterm' to find the exam review section.
examples.zh: 在「视频文字稿」里搜midterm，直接跳到期末复习那段。

examples.en: Reading the video transcript is faster than rewatching a fifty-minute lecture.
examples.zh: 读「视频文字稿」比重看五十分钟的课快多了。

words.enDefinition: watch a recorded lecture again to catch missed details

examples.en: I always rewatch the lecture the night before a midterm.
examples.zh: 期中考前一晚，我一定会「回看课程」。

examples.en: Rewatch the lecture where the professor solves the exact problem type on the quiz.
examples.zh: 考前把教授讲同类型题的那节课「回看」一遍。

collocations: rewatch the lecture before the exam

words.enDefinition: click a time marker to move straight to that part of a video

examples.en: The description lists timestamps, so jump to the timestamp for chapter five.
examples.zh: 简介里标了时间点，直接「跳转时间点」看第五章就行。

examples.en: I jumped to the timestamp where the TA demos the coding problem.
examples.zh: 我直接「跳到时间点」，看助教演示那道编程题。

words.enDefinition: make a video play faster to skip ahead through it

examples.en: Fast-forward through the ten minutes of announcements at the start.
examples.zh: 开头十分钟的通知部分直接「快进」。

examples.en: I fast-forwarded the setup steps but slowed down for the worked example.
examples.zh: 安装步骤我「快进」了，例题讲解部分放慢看。

words.enDefinition: stop a recorded lecture briefly to take notes or think

examples.en: Pause the lecture whenever the professor writes a formula on the screen.
examples.zh: 教授在屏幕上写公式时，就「暂停」记一下笔记。

examples.en: I paused the lecture mid-sentence to look up the unfamiliar term.
examples.zh: 我「暂停」了课程视频，去查那个生词。

collocations: pause the lecture to take notes

words.enDefinition: when a video's sound and picture don't match up in time

examples.en: The recording was out of sync, so the formula appeared before he explained it.
examples.zh: 回放「音画不同步」，公式比讲解先出现。

examples.en: If the audio is out of sync, reload the recording from the module page.
examples.zh: 如果「音画不同步」，就从模块页面重新加载回放。

collocations: the audio is out of sync

words.enDefinition: a video that captures exactly what happened on a screen

examples.en: I made a screen recording to show the TA exactly where the portal failed.
examples.zh: 我录了段「屏幕录制」，让助教看清门户到底哪一步出错。

examples.en: The professor posted a screen recording walking through the homework setup.
examples.zh: 教授上传了一段「屏幕录制」，演示怎么配置作业环境。

words.enDefinition: taking courses through the internet instead of in a classroom

examples.en: Online learning works fine for lectures but hands-on labs are harder.
examples.zh: 理论课用「在线学习」没问题，动手实验就难了。

examples.en: I saved two hours of commuting a day thanks to online learning.
examples.zh: 多亏「在线学习」，我每天省了两小时通勤。

words.enDefinition: a course split between in-person sessions and online sessions

examples.en: Our hybrid course format means Monday in person and Wednesday on Zoom.
examples.zh: 我们的「混合教学模式」是周一线下、周三Zoom。

examples.en: Check the syllabus for which weeks follow the hybrid course format.
examples.zh: 看教学大纲，确认哪些周采用「混合教学模式」。

collocations: switch to a hybrid course format

words.enDefinition: study that mixes online activities with face-to-face teaching

examples.en: Blended learning suits me because I can rewatch everything online.
examples.zh: 「混合式学习」很适合我，线上内容可以反复看。

examples.en: The department is expanding blended learning to more introductory courses.
examples.zh: 系里正把「混合式学习」推广到更多基础课。

words.enDefinition: learning from recorded materials on your own schedule, not live

examples.en: Asynchronous learning means I can do all my coursework at midnight.
examples.zh: 「异步学习」意味着我可以半夜把功课都做完。

examples.en: The course is mostly asynchronous learning, with one live seminar a week.
examples.zh: 这门课以「异步学习」为主，每周只有一次直播研讨。

words.enDefinition: a live online class where everyone attends at the same time

examples.en: The synchronous session is recorded for anyone in a different time zone.
examples.zh: 「同步课堂」会录像，方便不同时区的同学回看。

examples.en: Attendance counts only during the synchronous session, not the recordings.
examples.zh: 只有参加「同步课堂」才算出勤，看录像不算。

words.enDefinition: an online discussion where people post replies at different times

examples.en: Post in the asynchronous discussion by Wednesday and reply to two classmates by Friday.
examples.zh: 周三前在「异步讨论」发帖，周五前回复两位同学。

examples.en: Asynchronous discussion gives quieter students more time to think before they write.
examples.zh: 「异步讨论」让不太爱发言的同学有更多时间想好再写。

words.enDefinition: a course unit you complete on your own schedule online

examples.en: Each self-paced module has a checkpoint quiz at the end.
examples.zh: 每个「自定进度模块」结尾都有一道检查测验。

examples.en: Finish the self-paced module on lab safety before your first session.
examples.zh: 第一次实验课前要先完成实验安全的「自定进度模块」。

words.enDefinition: office hours held over video call instead of in an office

examples.en: Virtual office hours fill up fast, so book a slot days ahead.
examples.zh: 「线上答疑」名额抢得很快，要提前几天预约。

examples.en: I asked my question during virtual office hours and shared my screen.
examples.zh: 我在「线上答疑」时提问，还共享了屏幕。

words.enDefinition: a simulated experiment you complete online instead of in a lab

examples.en: The chemistry department swapped the titration for a virtual lab this week.
examples.zh: 化学系这周把滴定实验换成了「虚拟实验」。

examples.en: The virtual lab lets you retry the experiment without wasting reagents.
examples.zh: 「虚拟实验」可以反复重做，不浪费试剂。

words.enDefinition: an online seminar with a speaker and a large remote audience

examples.en: The career center hosts a resume webinar every Thursday at noon.
examples.zh: 就业中心每周四中午办一场简历「网络研讨会」。

examples.en: Register for the webinar early because the Zoom room caps at three hundred.
examples.zh: 「网络研讨会」名额只有三百人，要趁早报名。

words.enDefinition: switch classes or meetings from in person to remote

examples.en: The university moved all classes online during the ice storm.
examples.zh: 冻雨期间，学校把所有课程「转为线上」。

examples.en: If the campus closes, the professor will move the seminar online.
examples.zh: 如果校园关闭，教授会把研讨课「转为线上」。

words.enDefinition: take part in a class from somewhere else over the internet

examples.en: You can attend remotely once a week if you sign up in advance.
examples.zh: 提前申请的话，每周可以有一次「远程上课」。

examples.en: She attended remotely from the health center and stayed for the whole seminar.
examples.zh: 她在医务室「远程上课」，完整听完了研讨课。

words.enDefinition: studying from home or elsewhere through live or recorded classes

examples.en: Remote learning during my first year meant lectures at odd hours.
examples.zh: 大一的「远程学习」意味着上课时间乱七八糟。

examples.en: Some professors keep a remote learning option for students who travel.
examples.zh: 有些教授会为要出差的学生保留「远程学习」选项。

words.enDefinition: technology for holding meetings with live video over the internet

examples.en: Every department here uses different video conferencing tools for seminars.
examples.zh: 这里每个系研讨会用的「视频会议」软件都不一样。

examples.en: Good lighting makes a bigger difference than an expensive video conferencing camera.
examples.zh: 灯光好坏比贵的「视频会议」摄像头影响更大。

words.enDefinition: one topic on a discussion board with its original post and replies

examples.en: Start your discussion board thread with a question, not a summary.
examples.zh: 「讨论区主题帖」开头最好抛出问题，别只写总结。

examples.en: My discussion board thread got forty replies after I posted the practice questions.
examples.zh: 我发了练习题之后，「主题帖」收到四十多条回复。

collocations: reply to the discussion board thread

words.enDefinition: open a new topic for others to reply to on a forum

examples.en: Start a thread instead of burying your question under someone else's.
examples.zh: 有疑问就「发起新帖」，别埋在别人的帖子下面。

examples.en: She started a thread to find partners for the group presentation.
examples.zh: 她「发了个新帖」找小组展示的搭档。

collocations: start a thread in the forum

words.enDefinition: write a response under someone's post on a discussion board

examples.en: Post a reply that adds evidence instead of just agreeing.
examples.zh: 「回帖」要有论据，别只是简单附和。

examples.en: Remember to post a reply to two classmates before Sunday night.
examples.zh: 周日晚之前记得给两位同学「回帖」。

collocations: post a reply to two classmates
post a reply before the deadline

words.enDefinition: change your own post after publishing it on a forum

examples.en: You can edit your post until the deadline, so fix typos anytime.
examples.zh: 截止前都可以「编辑帖子」，随时改错别字。

examples.en: I edited my post to add the source the TA mentioned.
examples.zh: 我「编辑了帖子」，补上了助教提到的文献。

collocations: edit your post before the deadline

words.enDefinition: a short recorded video submitted instead of a written reply

examples.en: Our intro assignment is a one-minute video response for the class to watch.
examples.zh: 自我介绍作业是一分钟的「视频回复」，全班都会看。

examples.en: The professor allows a video response instead of a written discussion post.
examples.zh: 教授允许用「视频回复」代替书面讨论帖。

words.enDefinition: a first message introducing yourself to an online class

examples.en: Write your intro post with your major and one fun fact.
examples.zh: 「自我介绍帖」里写上自己的专业和一个有趣的冷知识。

examples.en: Her intro post mentioned she transferred from a university in Chengdu.
examples.zh: 她的「自我介绍帖」提到自己是从成都一所大学转来的。

words.enDefinition: posting your reply under a different topic than you meant

examples.en: I posted my question in the wrong thread and nobody answered for days.
examples.zh: 我把问题「发错了帖」，好几天没人回复。

examples.en: The TA moved my comment because it was in the wrong thread.
examples.zh: 助教把我的评论移走了，因为我「发错了主题帖」。

words.enDefinition: a direct note to one person that the class can't see

examples.en: Send the TA a private message if your issue involves grades.
examples.zh: 涉及成绩的问题，直接给助教发「私信」。

examples.en: She sent me a private message with her notes after I missed class.
examples.zh: 我缺课后，她用「私信」把笔记发给了我。

words.enDefinition: ask the whole class a quick question through a voting app

examples.en: The professor polls the class every ten minutes to keep us awake.
examples.zh: 教授每十分钟「发起一次课堂投票」，防止我们犯困。

examples.en: Polling the class showed half of us were confused by the derivation.
examples.zh: 「课堂投票」显示，一半同学没看懂那个推导。

collocations: poll the class to check understanding

words.enDefinition: a quick poll that records who showed up for an online class

examples.en: Answer the attendance poll within the first five minutes or you're marked absent.
examples.zh: 前五分钟内要完成「签到投票」，否则算缺勤。

examples.en: She missed the attendance poll and had to email the professor proof she was there.
examples.zh: 她错过了「签到投票」，只好发邮件向教授证明自己来过。

words.enDefinition: a simple opening poll used just to check who is present

examples.en: Today's attendance question was which city we'd most like to visit.
examples.zh: 今天的「签到问题」是最想去的城市是哪座。

examples.en: The attendance question appears on screen during the first two minutes.
examples.zh: 「签到问题」会在开课头两分钟出现在屏幕上。

words.enDefinition: a poll answered during class with results shown instantly

examples.en: The live poll showed most of us got the practice question wrong.
examples.zh: 「现场投票」显示大多数人练习题都做错了。

examples.en: Join the live poll from your phone while watching the lecture.
examples.zh: 看课时用手机参与「现场投票」。

words.enDefinition: the tally of answers shown after everyone votes

examples.en: The poll results appeared on screen and half the class picked B.
examples.zh: 「投票结果」一公布，全班一半人都选了B。

examples.en: The professor walked us through the poll results before explaining the answer.
examples.zh: 教授先带我们看「投票结果」，再讲解答案。

words.enDefinition: a poll where no one can see who chose which answer

examples.en: The anonymous poll lets us admit we're lost without embarrassment.
examples.zh: 「匿名投票」让我们可以坦然承认没听懂。

examples.en: The professor runs an anonymous poll before every exam to gauge stress levels.
examples.zh: 每次考前教授都会用「匿名投票」了解大家的压力。

words.enDefinition: a phone or web app teachers use to run fast quiz games

examples.en: The professor runs the warm-up through a quiz app with a leaderboard.
examples.zh: 教授用一个带排行榜的「答题App」做课前热身。

examples.en: Download the quiz app before class since registration eats up time.
examples.zh: 课前先下载好「答题App」，注册很费时间。

words.enDefinition: the short code that connects you to a poll or quiz room

examples.en: Type the join code on the screen to enter today's poll.
examples.zh: 把屏幕上的「加入码」输进去就能参加投票。

examples.en: The join code changes every lecture, so don't save the old one.
examples.zh: 每次课的「加入码」都不一样，别存旧的。

collocations: the join code on the slide

words.enDefinition: one complete run through an online quiz that gets scored

examples.en: You only get one quiz attempt, so double-check every answer.
examples.zh: 只有一次「答题机会」，每道题都要检查清楚。

examples.en: My second quiz attempt erased my first score, so read the rules carefully.
examples.zh: 第二次「答题机会」会覆盖第一次的成绩，务必看清规则。

words.enDefinition: an online quiz scored instantly by the system, not a person

examples.en: The auto-graded quiz shows your score the second you submit.
examples.zh: 「自动判分测验」一提交就出分。

examples.en: Our weekly auto-graded quiz lets us check answers right away.
examples.zh: 每周的「自动判分测验」可以马上核对答案。

words.enDefinition: correct answers and explanations shown right after you respond

examples.en: Instant feedback on the practice quiz shows which topic to review.
examples.zh: 练习测验的「即时反馈」能看出哪块内容需要复习。

examples.en: I like instant feedback because I fix mistakes while they're fresh.
examples.zh: 我喜欢「即时反馈」，趁记忆还新鲜就把错误改掉。

words.enDefinition: an ungraded online quiz for testing yourself before the real one

examples.en: Take the practice quiz twice before attempting the graded one.
examples.zh: 正式测验之前，先把「练习测验」做两遍。

examples.en: The practice quiz uses questions from the same bank as the final.
examples.zh: 「练习测验」的题目和期末考出自同一个题库。

words.enDefinition: a short quiz due before class to prove you did the reading

examples.en: The pre-class quiz locks at nine a.m., so no last-minute reading.
examples.zh: 「课前小测」九点关闭，别想临时抱佛脚。

examples.en: Our professor uses the pre-class quiz to decide what to review.
examples.zh: 教授根据「课前小测」的错题决定课上复习什么。

words.enDefinition: a surprise quiz that pops up in the middle of a lecture

examples.en: A mid-lecture quiz popped up during the statistics stream and panicked everyone.
examples.zh: 统计课上突然弹出「课中随堂测」，大家都慌了。

examples.en: The mid-lecture quiz counts toward participation, so don't zone out.
examples.zh: 「课中随堂测」计入参与分，千万别走神。

words.enDefinition: keep your microphone switched off when you're not speaking

examples.en: Stay muted during the guest lecture and type questions in the chat.
examples.zh: 嘉宾讲课时请「保持静音」，问题打在聊天区。

examples.en: I stay muted by default because my keyboard is incredibly loud.
examples.zh: 我默认「保持静音」，因为键盘声实在太响了。

words.enDefinition: said to tell someone the class can't hear them speaking

examples.en: The TA finally typed 'You're on mute' in the chat after thirty silent seconds.
examples.zh: 整整三十秒没声音后，助教终于在聊天区打出「你静音了」。

examples.en: I froze when the professor said 'You're on mute' because I thought my mic had died.
examples.zh: 教授说「你静音了」时我愣住了，还以为麦克风坏了。

collocations: type you're on mute in the chat
tell the speaker they're on mute

words.enDefinition: forget to mute, so everyone hears your background noise

examples.en: He left his mic on and the whole class heard him ordering bubble tea.
examples.zh: 他「忘了关麦克风」，全班都听见他在点奶茶。

examples.en: If you leave your mic on, even your keyboard sounds fill the meeting.
examples.zh: 只要「忘关麦克风」，连你敲键盘的声音全班都听得见。

words.enDefinition: a quick test that your microphone picks up your voice

examples.en: Do a mic check before the group presentation, not during it.
examples.zh: 小组展示前先做「麦克风测试」，别到时候才测。

examples.en: The TA ran a mic check with each presenter before we went live.
examples.zh: 正式开始前，助教给每位展示同学都做了「麦克风测试」。

collocations: a mic check before the presentation

words.enDefinition: switch on your webcam so others can see you

examples.en: Turn on your camera during presentations because it's basic politeness here.
examples.zh: 做展示时要「打开摄像头」，这是基本礼貌。

examples.en: The professor asks us to turn on our cameras when we ask questions.
examples.zh: 教授要求提问的时候「打开摄像头」。

collocations: turn on your camera for attendance
ask students to turn on their cameras
turn on your camera when speaking

words.enDefinition: leave your video switched off during a class or meeting

examples.en: In lectures of two hundred people, most students keep their camera off.
examples.zh: 两百人的大课上，大多数学生都「不开摄像头」。

examples.en: You can keep your camera off in this class as long as you unmute to answer.
examples.zh: 这门课可以「不开摄像头」，但回答问题时要开麦。

collocations: keep your camera off in big lectures
ask to keep your camera off

words.enDefinition: nervous or unwilling about appearing on camera

examples.en: I'm camera-shy, so I always sit out of the webcam's frame in my dorm.
examples.zh: 我有点「不愿出镜」，所以在宿舍总躲开摄像头拍到的范围。

examples.en: Even camera-shy students usually turn on their cameras for group presentations.
examples.zh: 就连「不愿出镜」的同学，小组展示时一般也会开摄像头。

words.enDefinition: face the webcam while speaking so you seem to make eye contact

examples.en: Look at the camera when you present instead of reading off your screen.
examples.zh: 做展示时请「看向镜头」，别一直盯着屏幕念稿。

examples.en: Looking at the camera instead of your second monitor makes you look engaged.
examples.zh: 「看着镜头」而不是盯着副屏，会显得更投入。

collocations: look at the camera when speaking
remember to look at the camera
look at the camera not the screen

words.enDefinition: not visible because your video or camera is switched off

examples.en: The professor went off camera for a minute to deal with her dog.
examples.zh: 教授「关掉镜头」处理了一下她的狗。

examples.en: Students say a lot more off camera than they do during discussion.
examples.zh: 「镜头外」同学们说的话，比讨论时多得多。

collocations: go off camera for a second

words.enDefinition: tiredness from staring at video calls all day

examples.en: By Friday afternoon my Zoom fatigue is so bad I can't process anything.
examples.zh: 到了周五下午，「视频会议疲劳」严重到我什么都听不进去。

examples.en: Back-to-back synchronous sessions gave the whole class Zoom fatigue by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 一连上了几节同步课，到周五下午全班都出现了「视频会议疲劳」。

words.enDefinition: leave your desk briefly during a class or meeting

examples.en: Step away during the break because nobody expects you to sit for two hours.
examples.zh: 休息时可以「暂时离开」，没人要求你连坐两小时。

examples.en: I stepped away for one minute and missed the attendance poll.
examples.zh: 我就「离开」了一分钟，结果错过了签到投票。

words.enDefinition: show your computer display to everyone else in the meeting

examples.en: Share your screen when you present so we can follow your slides.
examples.zh: 展示时请「共享屏幕」，方便大家跟着看幻灯片。

examples.en: The TA shared her screen and walked us through the citation format.
examples.zh: 助教「共享屏幕」，带我们过了一遍引用格式。

collocations: share your screen during the presentation

words.enDefinition: broadcasting what's on your display to the rest of the call

examples.en: Screen sharing stopped working right when my part of the presentation started.
examples.zh: 轮到我讲的时候，「屏幕共享」偏偏坏了。

examples.en: Turn on screen sharing sound if your slides have video clips.
examples.zh: 幻灯片里有视频的话，记得开「屏幕共享」的声音。

words.enDefinition: end the broadcast of your screen to the meeting

examples.en: Remember to stop sharing before you open your grades tab.
examples.zh: 打开成绩页面之前，记得先「停止共享」。

examples.en: He forgot to stop sharing, so the whole class watched him browse job listings.
examples.zh: 他忘了「停止共享」，全班都看到他在浏览招聘信息。

words.enDefinition: asked to confirm the audience sees your shared display

examples.en: He paused mid-slide and asked, 'Can you see my screen?'
examples.zh: 他讲到一半停下来问：「能看到我的屏幕吗？」

examples.en: Ask 'Can you see my screen?' early because silent minutes are worse.
examples.zh: 早点问一句「能看到我的屏幕吗」，免得冷场好几分钟。

collocations: ask can you see my screen

words.enDefinition: post a link or question in the meeting chat box

examples.en: Don't interrupt, just drop it in the chat and the TA will answer.
examples.zh: 别打断，把问题「发到聊天区」，助教会回复。

examples.en: She dropped the reading link in the chat so nobody had to search.
examples.zh: 她把阅读链接「发到了聊天区」，大家不用自己找。

collocations: drop the link in the chat
drop your question in the chat

words.enDefinition: the side window in a meeting where typed messages appear

examples.en: Keep the chat panel open so you catch links the TA posts.
examples.zh: 把「聊天面板」开着，助教发的链接才不会错过。

examples.en: Half the good questions in lecture end up buried in the chat panel.
examples.zh: 课上很多好问题最后都沉底在「聊天面板」里。

collocations: scroll back through the chat panel

words.enDefinition: stop hearing someone because their sound suddenly failed

examples.en: Her audio cut out mid-sentence, so we lost the last example.
examples.zh: 她讲到一半「声音中断」，最后一个例题没听到。

examples.en: If your audio cuts out, rejoin the meeting instead of troubleshooting on camera.
examples.zh: 如果「声音中断」，直接重新入会，别当着全班排查。

words.enDefinition: lose your internet connection suddenly in the middle of something

examples.en: The dorm Wi-Fi cut out during the quiz, and support took an hour.
examples.zh: 做测验时宿舍「Wi-Fi断了」，报修等了一个小时。

examples.en: My Wi-Fi cut out right as the professor was explaining the curve.
examples.zh: 教授讲到评分曲线一半，我的「Wi-Fi断了」。

words.enDefinition: said when someone's audio is choppy and hard to hear

examples.en: The professor said, 'You're breaking up,' and asked me to move closer to the router.
examples.zh: 教授说「你声音断断续续」，让我离路由器近一点。

examples.en: Everyone typed 'you're breaking up' in the chat until she reconnected.
examples.zh: 聊天区里刷满了「你声音断断续续」，直到她重新连上。

words.enDefinition: extra sound like traffic or roommates that the mic picks up

examples.en: Stay muted when there's background noise so the lecture stays clear.
examples.zh: 有「背景噪音」就保持静音，别影响大家听课。

examples.en: My background noise is the dining hall, so I answer questions from a study room.
examples.zh: 我这边的「背景噪音」是食堂，所以提问时都去自习室。

words.enDefinition: any problem with sound during an online class or call

examples.en: If you have an audio issue, switch to your phone's dial-in number.
examples.zh: 遇到「音频故障」，就改用手机拨入号码。

examples.en: Half the class reported an audio issue with yesterday's guest lecture.
examples.zh: 昨天嘉宾课，一半同学都反映有「音频故障」。

collocations: an audio issue with the recording

words.enDefinition: have your saved work disappear, often after a page crashes

examples.en: The browser refreshed itself and I lost my progress on the quiz.
examples.zh: 浏览器自己刷新了，我的测验「进度全丢了」。

examples.en: Save a draft often so a crash doesn't lose your progress.
examples.zh: 勤保存草稿，免得页面崩溃「丢了进度」。

words.enDefinition: a quick test of camera, sound, and internet before an online session

examples.en: Do a tech check with your group the night before the presentation.
examples.zh: 展示前一晚，和小组一起做一次「设备检查」。

examples.en: The professor holds a five-minute tech check before every online exam.
examples.zh: 每次线上考试前，教授都会安排五分钟「设备检查」。

collocations: a quick tech check before class
do a tech check with the group

words.enDefinition: a team assignment completed together through calls and shared files

examples.en: Our online group project lives in a shared folder and a weekly call.
examples.zh: 我们的「线上小组项目」靠共享文件夹加每周通话推进。

examples.en: Time zones nearly killed our online group project until we settled on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 时差差点毁掉我们的「线上小组项目」，最后定在周日上午。

collocations: an online group project over Zoom

words.enDefinition: divide presentation slides among group members so everyone prepares a part

examples.en: We split the slides three ways and rehearsed over Zoom on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们把幻灯片「分成三份」，周六在Zoom上排练。

examples.en: Split the slides early so nobody makes two the night before.
examples.zh: 早点「分工做幻灯片」，免得有人拖到前一晚赶两张。

collocations: split the slides among four people

words.enDefinition: start a quick voice or video call with someone

examples.en: Let's hop on a call and finish the outline together tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚咱们「开个语音」，一起把大纲弄完。

examples.en: She hopped on a call with me to debug my code before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止前她和我「开了个语音」，帮我调通了代码。

collocations: hop on a call after dinner

words.enDefinition: at the same moment something happens, with no delay

examples.en: We edited the essay in real time while talking through each paragraph.
examples.zh: 我们边讨论每段怎么改，边「实时」编辑论文。

examples.en: The shared doc updates in real time, so you can see who's typing.
examples.zh: 共享文档「实时」更新，能看到谁正在输入。

collocations: edit the doc in real time

words.enDefinition: a saved video of an online meeting for people who missed it

examples.en: She shares the meeting recording after every group call for the member in Beijing.
examples.zh: 每次小组通话后，她都会把「会议录像」分享给在北京的那位组员。

examples.en: Watch the meeting recording in the shared folder before Thursday's class.
examples.zh: 周四上课前，去共享文件夹里看「会议录像」。

collocations: the meeting recording is in the folder

words.enDefinition: deliver the section of a group presentation assigned to you

examples.en: Don't panic because I can present your part if your flight lands late.
examples.zh: 别慌，你航班晚点的话，我可以替你「讲你那部分」。

examples.en: Practice until you can present your part without reading every line.
examples.zh: 多练几遍，做到「讲自己那部分」时不用逐字念稿。

words.enDefinition: send your finished work to the course site for grading

examples.en: Upload an assignment early because the site slows down right before deadlines.
examples.zh: 作业要早点「上传」，截止前网站会特别卡。

examples.en: I uploaded the assignment from the library an hour before it was due.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆「上传了作业」，赶在截止前一小时。

collocations: upload an assignment as a PDF
upload the assignment before the deadline

words.enDefinition: add a document or image to a message or submission box

examples.en: Attach a file instead of pasting the whole essay into the text box.
examples.zh: 别把整篇论文粘进文本框，要「添加附件」。

examples.en: She attached the wrong file and had to email the TA a corrected version.
examples.zh: 她「添加附件」时传错了文件，只好把正确版本发给助教。

collocations: attach a file to the submission

words.enDefinition: save lecture slides from the course site to your computer

examples.en: Download the slides before class so you can annotate them offline.
examples.zh: 课前先「下载课件」，方便离线做笔记。

examples.en: She downloaded the slides on campus because her apartment Wi-Fi is unreliable.
examples.zh: 她趁在学校「下载课件」，公寓的网太不稳定。

collocations: the slides are available to download
download the slides as a PDF
